Following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assault on Edan Base|victory]] over [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces at [[Edan Base]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]], the Rebellion struck back by '''assaulting''' the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']]. An Alliance team infiltrated the ''Havoc'', planting [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] near the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]]. Once the explosives were triggered, the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] aft shields failed. The [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Vindicator (light freighter)|''Vindicator'']], refitted as a [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] with quad [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launchers]], used the opportunity to launch a salvo of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the ''Havoc''{{'s}} [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]]. The resulting explosions tore through the Star Destroyer, leaving it a hulk.
